title: THE DOUBLE-EDGED SWORD OF BIG DATA AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY FOR THE DISADVANTAGED: A CAUTIONARY TALE FROM OPEN BANKING
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and indirect discrimination in the context of credit scoring and financial vulnerability. While it is grounded in the ethics of AI and fairness, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical frameworks as a subject of study; rather, it applies statistical fairness metrics to a financial machine learning application.
